info.name: ZyraTech Hub API - Production
info.description: Complete API documentation for ZyraTech Hub STEM Education Platform. Base URL: http://3.16.26.212:5000/api — 19 modules, 100+ endpoints. To get started: run the Login request, copy the token from the response, and paste it into the admin_token collection variable.

variable.description: JWT Admin Token (Set this after logging in)

item.name: 1. Authentication & Profile
item.description: Login, 2FA, profile management, session management, password flows, and KYC submission.

request.description: Authenticates an admin. Returns token + user, OR returns requires2FA + tempToken if 2FA is enabled.
Complete login when 2FA is enabled. Send the tempToken from login + the 6-digit code from Google Authenticator.
Get a new access token using a refresh token.
Request a password reset email.
Reset password using the token from the email link.
Get the currently authenticated user's full profile.
Invalidate the current session and log out.
Change password while logged in. Requires current password.
Submit KYC verification documents. Uses multipart/form-data with 'documents' file field and 'documentType' text field. Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data in Postman.
Update profile details (firstName, lastName, phone, location, department, bio). Email is LOCKED and cannot be changed here.

body.raw:
{
  "firstName": "John",
  "lastName": "Doe",
  "phone": "+233201234567",
  "location": "Accra, Ghana",
  "department": "Engineering",
  "bio": "Full Stack Engineer at ZyraTech Hub"
}

request.description: Save notification toggle states as a JSON object.
Generate a new TOTP secret and QR code data URL. The user scans this QR with Google Authenticator.
Verify the 6-digit code from Google Authenticator to activate 2FA on the account.
Turn off Two-Factor Authentication.
List all active login sessions for the current user (device, IP, last activity).
Sign out of every device except the current one.
Revoke (log out) a specific session by its ID.

item.name: 2. User Management (Super Admin)
item.description: Manage admin users. All endpoints require super_admin role.

request.description: List all admin users with pagination.
Get a specific admin user by ID.
Create a new admin user. They receive an email with temporary credentials.
Update an admin user's details.
Update an admin's module permissions.
Reactivate a deactivated admin account.
Deactivate an admin account (soft delete).
Permanently delete an admin user.

item.name: 3. Training Courses
item.description: Public course listings and admin CRUD for training courses.

request.description: List all published training courses for the public website.
Get full details of a specific training course by ID.
List all courses including drafts and archived.
Create a new training course.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Advanced Robotics",
  "slug": "advanced-robotics",
  "description": "Learn robotics fundamentals and build your own robot.",
  "duration": "12 weeks",
  "format": "Hybrid",
  "price": 3500,
  "category": "advanced",
  "status": "active"
}

request.description: Update a training course.
Delete a training course.

item.name: 4. Training Applications & Enrollments
item.description: Public application form and admin enrollment management.

request.description: Public form for students to apply for a training course. Supports optional CV file upload via multipart/form-data.
List all training applications with pagination. Filter by status: pending, approved, rejected.
Get full details of a specific enrollment.
Approve or reject a training application.

item.name: 5. Jobs & Job Applications
item.description: Public job listings, public application submission, and admin management.

request.description: List active job openings for the careers page.
Get full details of a specific job listing.
Submit a job application. Uses multipart/form-data with 'resumeFile' and optional 'additionalDocumentFile' fields.

body.raw:
{
  "jobId": "JOB_ID_HERE",
  "applicantName": "Bob Worker",
  "email": "bob@example.com",
  "phone": "0209998888",
  "coverLetter": "I would love to work here."
}

request.description: List all job listings including drafts and closed.
Create a new job listing.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Software Engineer",
  "department": "Engineering",
  "location": "Accra, Ghana",
  "type": "Full-time",
  "description": "Build awesome things.",
  "requirements": "NodeJS, React, TypeScript",
  "status": "active"
}

request.description: Update a job listing.
Delete a job listing.
List all job applications submitted by candidates.
Get full details of a specific job application.
Update the status of a job application (reviewed, shortlisted, rejected, etc).

item.name: 6. Payments & Transactions
item.description: Payment initialization, verification, webhooks, and admin transaction management.

request.description: Initialize a Paystack payment transaction for an approved course application.
Verify a Paystack payment after redirect.
Webhook endpoint called by Paystack servers. DO NOT test manually — Paystack sends this automatically.
View all payment transactions with pagination.
Initiate a refund for a specific transaction.

item.name: 7. Settings
item.description: Public site settings and admin settings management. Settings are stored in the database by category (branding, contact, social, email, payments, general).

request.description: Get all public site settings (branding, contact info, social links, etc).
Get all settings including private ones (SMTP, API keys, etc).
Update a single setting by key.
Update multiple settings at once.

item.name: 8. CMS Content
item.description: Content Management System for dynamic page sections (hero slides, features, etc) and custom pages (About, Terms, etc).

request.description: Get published content items for a given section slug (e.g. hero_slides, features, services).
Get a published CMS page by section slug.
List all content items for a section including drafts.
Get a specific content item by ID.
Create a new content item (hero slide, feature block, etc).

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Welcome to ZyraTech",
  "section": "hero_slides",
  "content": "Empowering STEM Education in Ghana",
  "status": "published",
  "order": 1
}

request.description: Update a content item.
Reorder content items within a section.
Delete a content item.
Get a CMS page by section slug (admin view includes drafts).
Create or update a CMS page.

item.name: 9. Blog Articles
item.description: Public blog and admin article management with image upload support.

request.description: List published blog articles for the public website.
Get a single published blog article by its slug.
Upload an image for use in blog articles. Uses multipart/form-data with 'file' field.
List all blog articles including drafts.
Get a specific article by ID.
Create a new blog article.

item.name: 11. Gallery
item.description: Photo gallery with albums and media items. Supports image upload, reordering, and full media CRUD.

request.description: List all published gallery albums with their media.
Get a specific album and all its media items.
Upload an image for gallery use. Uses multipart/form-data with 'file' field.
List all albums including unpublished.
Get a specific album by ID.
Create a new gallery album.
Update an album.
Delete an album and all its media.
Add a media item (image/video) to an album.
Reorder media items within an album.
Update a media item's caption or details.
Remove a media item from an album.

request.description: List all partnership applications.

item.description: Public contact form and admin inquiry management.

request.description: Submit a contact form message. Required: fullName, email, message.

Delete a message.
